name: Meeting Room Registration Form
description: Use the meeting room registration form template to simplify the process of reserving meeting rooms.

7.label: Meeting Room Booking Form
7.description: This form lets people request meeting room reservations by selecting the room and time blocks they need. Customize the room names and time slots to match your facility. Setup Tips: [] Change Room A/B/C labels to your actual room names or numbers. [] Adjust the time block options to match your operating hours [] Add a Date/Time field if you're booking rooms more than one day in advance [] Include equipment checkboxes (projector, whiteboard, etc.) if you provide setup services [] Connect to Google Sheets in Marketing » Integrations to track all bookings in a shared spreadsheet [] Set up confirmation emails that include room location and access instructions Pro Tip: Connect to Google Sheets using WPForms Pro integrations to maintain a live spreadsheet of all bookings that staff can reference before approving new requests.
7.expanded-description: Common Additions: [] Date Picker: Add a calendar field if people book rooms days or weeks in advance instead of same-day requests. [] Equipment requests: Include checkboxes for available equipment (projector, speakerphone, whiteboard, TV screen, video conferencing setup). [] Capacity check: Add informational text showing how many people each room holds so bookers pick appropriate spaces. [] Meeting purpose: Add a dropdown asking what type of meeting (team meeting, client presentation, training, interview) if you want to track room usage patterns. [] Recurring bookings: Add a checkbox asking if this is a recurring meeting and a text field to describe the schedule. Handle these manually or set up automated entries.
